channel.title: The Drill Down: Indianapolis Colts
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 11: Colts at Texans
item.description: Thu 11/19 · 8:15 PM ET | Line: HOU -12.5 · O/U 44.5 | Model HOU 66% vs. market 85% | Houston needs its deep throws to the right, 19% of passes and the league's most, to find an Indianapolis secondary that concedes +0.34 EPA per throw there. Daniel Jones, ranked 29th of 31, must absorb a Texans pass rush that brings pressure on 23% of dropbacks, eighth-best in the league. Our model gives Houston 66% against the market's 85%, with the passing matchup doing most of the work.

item.title: Week 10: Dolphins at Colts
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: IND -4.5 · O/U 37.5 | Model IND 58% vs. market 66% | Indianapolis has to lean on the run, because Miami's defense ranks 31st against designed runs and allows -0.07 EPA per carry. Daniel Jones, who averages -1.30 EPA per dropback under pressure, must survive a Miami pass rush that ranks 14th. Our model has Indianapolis at 58%, well under the market, and the rushing matchup, worth 3.5 points, drives most of that gap.
